findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.citation_text:
4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

The test strips available for CL sanitizers are observed discolored. They are also not functioning correctly when used. The PIC was shown and discarded the test strips during this inspection. They then acquired new strips during the inspection to correct the immediate violation. Ensure that test strips in the facility function correctly at all times.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.

Dust accumulation is observed on the vent cover in the walk in cooler. The PIC is instructed to clean and maintain this clean at all times moving forward to prevent dust flying into foods in the cooler. Ensure that all physical facilities are maintained clean at all times.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
3-501.17: (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf). (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date (Pf). (C) Combined portions of food shall retain the date marking of the earliest-prepared food (Pf). (D) Approved date marking systems (C).

A gallon of milk in the walk in cooler is observed partially used and without a date mark. Per the PIC it was opened yesterday for use in mac n’ cheese. Date marking was discussed and a date placed on the milk to correct.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
4-903.11: (A) clean FOOD-CONTACT surfaces shall be stored: in clean, dry location, not exposed to splash or other contamination, and at least 6 inches above floor. (B) clean EQUIPMENT shall be stored in self-draining position that allows air drying, covered or inverted. (D) Items that are kept in closed PACKAGES may be stored below 6 inches if on dollies, pallets, racks, and skids properly designed. 

The bottle of test strips (for sanitizer concentration) is observed stored in a container in contact with the food contact surface of batter mixers. A conversation was conducted with the PIC and the mixer was moved to dish for cleaning. The outside of test strip containers is not cleaned/sanitized and should not be in contact with any food contact surfaces.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria.

The bucket of sanitizer in the area next to the walk in cooler is using a quat based sanitizer that would not register on inspector or facility test strips. Bucket was remade using bleach to correct concentrations.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
Buckets of sanitizer and soapy water observed unlabeled. Label working containers so that contents are apparent. CORRECTED- Containers labeled to indicate contents.
7-102.11: Working containers used for storing POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS such as cleaners and SANITIZERS taken from bulk supplies shall be clearly and individually identified with the common name of the material. [Pf]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114  (P) Quaternary ammonium sanitizer measured <100 ppm in the back prep area. Sanitizer bucket for wiping tables was observed at a concentration of 100ppm. Maintain concentration at 200 ppm to 400 ppm as indicated on manufacturer's label. Solutions was remade at the proper concentration.
Make sure wiping clothes are properly submerged in solution between uses.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Observed a bucket with clothes in it used for sanitizing tables. The clothes were wet, but not being stored in a sanitizer solution. Manager stated she was unaware they had to be stored in a sanitizer solution. Manager educated staff during inspection.
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed both faucets at the three compartment sink to have a leak from the top of the faucet when they are turned on. Ensure that plumbing is maintained in good repair and all repairs are done by an Illinois licensed plumber.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed the employee hand sink to have no caulking noted and a gap between the sink and the wall. Manager was notified and she brought maintenance in during inspection. Ensure that the hand sink is caulked to provide a smooth and easily cleanable surface. 
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Observed 2 boxes of single-service containers (plastic clamshells) stored on the floor of the store room.
Store single service items 6 inches off the floor to protect against potential contamination.
**Note** A delivery had just been made by vendor.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.
CORRECTED = Boxes were placed on shelf.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Observed that one of the hand sinks did not have a supply of towels.
Provide soap and towels at each lavatory. 
750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.
CORRECTED = A new roll of towels was placed in dispenser.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
Observed that the damp mop was stored in the bucket between uses.
Store mop hanging upright between uses to promote air drying.
750-1390 Maintenance and cleaning tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners and similar equipment shall be maintained and stored in a way that does not contaminate food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed that the gasket seal of the True freezer 1 door is ripped. 
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.
Repair the door seal gasket.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed that the floor tiles under the dish machine and next to the 3 compartment sink are cracked and chipped.
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.
Repair the floor tiles in these areas.
**REPEAT Violation**

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed there are floor tiles under the dish machine that are missing, and / or in disrepair. There are also floor tiles that are cracked or chipped located in the following areas: 1) by the door in the dry storage room, 2) by the convection oven, and 3) by the door to the walk in cooler. 
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.
** Repeat Violation**

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment:
Observed a can of applesauce in the can storage rack that was dented along the seam.
750-100 Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption.
Discard dented cans.
CORRECTED= Can was segregated for disposal.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed there are some floor tiles under the dish machine that are missing, or cracked.
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.
Repair floor tiles.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:

750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.
Provide properly constructed and clean floors.
REPEAT= This repair will be scheduled after the school year ends.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.citation_text:
750.650 Food contact surfaces shall be easily cleanable, smooth, and free of cracks, chips, or pits.
The wooden prep tables in kithen are wpood surfaced. The table tops do not appear to be sealed or coated. These raw wood surfaces should be sealed.
Seal tabletops so as to be smooth.
